Fixed and verified. Bug: `d.tz(input, timezone)` always did `d.utc(input).valueOf()`, which treats the input as a UTC wall-clock time — correct for strings, but wrong for a numeric timestamp, a native `Date`, or an existing Day.js object, where it discarded the absolute instant and shifted it by the target zone's offset. Fix: non-string inputs now go through the instant-preserving path `d(input).tz(timezone)`. Verified: `test/plugin/timezone.test.js` 14/14 pass, full suite 56 suites / 524 tests all pass, and a scratch test named `Parse parse timestamp, js Date, Day.js object` (outside the repo) passes with the fix and fails on the baseline.
Got it — investigating the weekYear plugin bug now, alongside the other fixes in progress. ETA ~10 min.

`plural('минута_минуты_минут', 22)` returns `'минуты'` — the second form. Trace: `22 % 10 === 1` is false; `22 % 10 >= 2 && 22 % 10 <= 4` is true (2), and `22 % 100 < 10 || 22 % 100 >= 20` is true (22 ≥ 20), so it takes `forms[1]`. (In context, `relativeTimeWithPlural` would render it as `22 минуты`.)

Fixed and verified. Bug: `src/plugin/weekYear/index.js` only handled the December→next-year direction; a January date belonging to the last week (52/53) of the previous week-year (e.g. 2021-01-01 → week 53 of 2020, which happens with `yearStart: 4`) returned the calendar year. Fix: added the missing branch `if (month === 0 && weekOfYear >= 52) return year - 1`. Verified: targeted weekYear/weekOfYear tests 10/10 pass, full suite 56 suites / 524 tests all pass, and a scratch comparison against `moment.isoWeekYear()` over 2000–2030 shows 0 mismatches with `yearStart: 4` (4 mismatches before the fix).

Fixed and verified. Bug: `proto.tz` computed the target offset as `localUtcOffset - diff` where `localUtcOffset = d().utcOffset()` was captured once at plugin-load time, so `format('Z')`/`ZZ` was wrong whenever the machine's offset at the converted instant differed from the load-time offset (e.g. `dayjs('2020-01-01').tz('Asia/Kolkata').format('Z')` gave `+06:30` instead of `+05:30` under TZ=America/New_York). Fix: compute the target zone's offset directly from the instant via the existing `tzOffset(+this.toDate(), timezone)` helper and use it in `.utcOffset(targetOffset, true)`. Verified: timezone tests 14/14 pass, full suite 56 suites / 524 tests all pass, and a differential check against `moment-timezone` (12 zones × 8 dates incl. DST transitions, plus chained conversions) shows 0 `Z`/`ZZ` mismatches in five different TZs (48 mismatches before the fix).
